title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: We're looking for an experienced Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. You'll work on building scalable web applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Must have 5+ years of experience with modern JavaScript frameworks and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP). Strong problem-solving skills and experience with microservices architecture required.

title: Frontend Developer (Remote)
description: Join our remote-first team as a Frontend Developer. Build beautiful, responsive user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. 3+ years of experience required. Experience with Next.js, state management (Redux/Zustand), and testing frameworks (Jest/Cypress) is a plus.

title: Backend Engineer - Python
description: Seeking a Backend Engineer with strong Python skills. You'll design and implement RESTful APIs, work with Django/FastAPI, and optimize database performance. Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker required. Knowledge of Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Summer internship opportunity for Computer Science students. Work on real-world projects using JavaScript, React, and Node.js. Gain hands-on experience with agile development, code reviews, and modern software practices. Must be currently enrolled in a CS program.

title: Data Scientist
description: Looking for a Data Scientist to build ML models and extract insights from large datasets. Strong Python skills required (pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow). Experience with SQL, data visualization (Tableau/PowerBI), and statistical analysis. PhD or Master's in related field preferred.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Join our DevOps team to build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage Kubernetes clusters, and ensure system reliability. Strong experience with AWS, Terraform, Docker, and monitoring tools (Prometheus/Grafana) required. On-call rotation required.

title: Mobile Developer - React Native
description: Build cross-platform mobile applications using React Native. 4+ years of mobile development experience required. Knowledge of iOS/Android native development, app store deployment, and mobile UI/UX best practices essential. Experience with Firebase and push notifications a plus.

title: Product Manager
description: Lead product strategy and roadmap for our SaaS platform. Work closely with engineering, design, and stakeholders to deliver customer value. 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS. Strong analytical skills and experience with product analytics tools required.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Create beautiful, user-centered designs for web and mobile applications. Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, and design systems required. 3+ years of experience with user research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. Portfolio required.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy ML models at scale. Strong Python skills with PyTorch/TensorFlow required. Experience with MLOps, model deployment, and cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex AI). Knowledge of NLP and computer vision is a plus. PhD preferred but not required.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Develop and maintain automated test suites using Selenium, Cypress, and Jest. 3+ years of QA experience with strong programming skills (JavaScript/Python). Experience with API testing, performance testing, and CI/CD integration required.

title: Contract Frontend Developer
description: 6-month contract for an experienced Frontend Developer. Build responsive web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript. Must be available 40 hours/week. Experience with component libraries and state management required. Immediate start preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description: Design and build data pipelines using Apache Spark, Airflow, and Kafka. Strong SQL and Python skills required. Experience with data warehousing (Snowflake/Redshift), ETL processes, and data modeling. 4+ years of experience in data engineering.

title: Security Engineer
description: Protect our infrastructure and applications from security threats. Experience with penetration testing, security audits, and compliance (SOC2/ISO27001) required. Knowledge of OWASP, encryption, and security best practices essential. Security certifications (CISSP/CEH) preferred.

title: Part-Time Web Developer
description: Part-time position (20 hours/week) building websites for small businesses. WordPress, HTML/CSS/JavaScript skills required. Flexible schedule. Great for students or those seeking work-life balance. Experience with SEO and responsive design a plus.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Design and implement cloud solutions on AWS/Azure. 7+ years of experience with cloud architecture, infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and enterprise-scale deployments. AWS/Azure certifications required. Experience with multi-cloud strategies preferred.

title: Junior Software Developer
description: Entry-level position for recent graduates or career changers. Learn and grow with our team while building web applications using JavaScript, React, and Node.js. Strong fundamentals and eagerness to learn required. Mentorship provided. 0-2 years of experience.

title: Blockchain Developer
description: Develop smart contracts and decentralized applications. Strong Solidity and Web3.js skills required. Experience with Ethereum, testing frameworks (Hardhat/Truffle), and DeFi protocols. Knowledge of security best practices and gas optimization essential.

title: Technical Writer
description: Create clear, comprehensive technical documentation for developers. Strong writing skills and ability to understand complex technical concepts required. Experience with API documentation, tutorials, and developer portals. Knowledge of Markdown, Git, and documentation tools.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Ensure high availability and performance of production systems. Strong Linux, scripting (Python/Bash), and monitoring skills required. Experience with incident management, capacity planning, and automation. 5+ years of SRE/operations experience.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Summer internship for students interested in data analysis. Learn SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools. Work on real business problems and present findings to stakeholders. Must be pursuing degree in Statistics, Economics, or related field.

title: Full-Stack Developer - MERN Stack
description: Build modern web applications using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. 3+ years of full-stack development experience required. Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills, RESTful API design, and database optimization. Experience with GraphQL and microservices a plus.

title: Game Developer - Unity
description: Create engaging mobile and PC games using Unity and C#. 4+ years of game development experience required. Strong understanding of game physics, AI, and optimization. Experience with multiplayer networking and monetization strategies preferred. Portfolio required.

title: Solutions Architect
description: Design technical solutions for enterprise clients. Strong communication and technical skills required. Experience with cloud platforms, system integration, and enterprise architecture patterns. 6+ years of experience. Travel required (25%).

title: AI Research Engineer
description: Conduct cutting-edge AI research and develop novel algorithms. PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field required. Strong publication record and experience with deep learning frameworks. Knowledge of transformers, reinforcement learning, and LLMs essential.
